properties: Composition commits once; selection gestures cannot also dispatch input; clipboard completion stays with its captured terminal
assessment: DOM/IME/device behavior is observed directly; retain explicit event-sequence regressions
remaining: IME/browser/clipboard behavior depends on platform events; supported browser scenarios are exercised, not every device keyboard.
evidenceDecision: Real xterm/browser composition, touch and clipboard transitions are the executable subject; synthetic abstract key transitions would omit the shipped core duplication that the regression reproduces. v0.8.5: Hidden-cursor IME positioning is checked directly at ANSI serialization and browser-frame decoding; no ownership or ordering model changes.
